messages:
casey (AE): Heads-up — EmpowerML asked for a throughput & latency validation run next week. They want multi-region burst behavior + security checklist answers.
devon (SE): Thanks. Do we have target QPS/concurrency and model size from them?
alyssa (EmpowerML PM): Hey all — target is 400 qps sustained, 1200 qps burst for 30s, 512 token avg, 3k max. Using gpt-like open model (7B) or equivalent. Need results + cost delta between hosted vs dedicated.
ian (Perf): Ok. For 7B @512 tokens that burst profile looks like ~X tokens/s. Recommend: run phases — smoke (10 qps), ramp (50->400 over 20m), sustained (60m @400), bursts (4x 30s at 1200). Record p50/p90/p99 tail.
devon (SE): Agree. Add cold-cache vs warm-cache runs. We'll validate prefix/KV cache effect. Also test model variant with int8 quant to show cost savings.
casey (AE): Customer asks about SLA during burst. Can we say hosted will fallback to compatible variant if overloaded?
devon (SE): Yes, routing policy can fall back to lower-capacity variant (quantized or shorter-seq config). We'll surface expected latency regressions.
marta (InfoSec): I need to review the security questionnaire — they flagged HSM for key management and SC-2 audit evidence. Also asked for network diagrams for Private deployment.
alyssa (EmpowerML PM): We can do Private if needed, but initial POC should be hosted to move faster. HSM requirement is negotiable for prod.
ian (Perf): Test plan details: test runner = k6 + custom prompt payloads. Instances per region: 3 load agents (us-east1, europe-west1, asia-southeast1). Duration ~3.5 hours incl. cooldown. Capture node-level metrics + per-request traces.
devon (SE): I'll prepare runbook. Key configs to include:
```
model: redwood-7b-open
seq_len: 512
caching: enabled/disabled
batch_size: adaptive
quant: int8 vs fp16
route_policy: primary->fallback
```
ian (Perf): Add header for simulating network jitter to emulate mobile clients. We should also run a stress test against metadata service to ensure control plane doesn't throttle.
deploy-bot: deployment 3305002500: perf-cluster-us-east created by devon (SE) :rocket:
casey (AE): Pricing question from their procurement: estimate monthly cost for 400 qps sustained 24/7 vs dedicated 1x p6d-equivalent pool. Rough numbers?
devon (SE): Quick ballpark (not final): hosted optimized w/ int8 caching = ~$35k/mo. Dedicated reserved pool + infra = ~$55-70k/mo depending on util. I'll produce a breakdown after we run sample baseline.
alyssa (EmpowerML PM): Timeline constraints — can we run baseline Wed morning PST?
ian (Perf): Wed 09:00 PST works. I'll schedule load agents and set dashboards. Need credentials for tenant and API key scoped to test model only.
marta (InfoSec): Provide temporary API key with limited scope, rotate after test. Send network diagram PDF before Wed + answers to these sec q's: HSM support, data residency, audit reports availability.
casey (AE): I'll send them the checklist and ask for a signed NDA for the deeper sec docs.
devon (SE): Action items: 1) I prepare runbook + k6 scripts (due Tue EOD). 2) Ian sets dashboards & metrics capture (Tue EOD). 3) Casey sends sec checklist & NDA (today). 4) Marta reviews sec responses (Wed morning).
alyssa (EmpowerML PM): Sounds good. One more: can you include a short writeup in the results showing cost per 1M tokens at each config (hosted fp16, hosted int8, dedicated)? We need that for procurement.
ian (Perf): Will include token-level cost breakdown and p95/p99 latency tables per config.
devon (SE): FYI — possible enterprise blocker: if they insist on HSM during POC, we need Private deploy approval and infra lead time ~3 weeks. Flagging now.
casey (AE): Noted. I'll push them to accept hosted POC and agree HSM for prod.
marta (InfoSec): If they insist, we can run an isolated Private eval but need SOW and procurement.
alyssa (EmpowerML PM): Ok we'll aim for hosted. NDA coming shortly. Thanks team! :pray:
casey (AE): Great — I'll update the customer and post the runbook link when ready. :thumbsup:
